<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <title>Low-Poly 3D Humanoid Animation</title>
    <style>
        body { margin: 0; overflow: hidden; }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
<script type="module">
    import * as THREE from './three.module.js';

    const scene = new THREE.Scene();
    const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(75, window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight, 0.1, 1000);
    const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true });

    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
    document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

    const geometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(1, 1, 1);
    const humanoid = new THREE.Group();

    const material = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x00ff00 });
    const body = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(1, 1.5, 0.5), material);
    const head = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.5, 0.5, 0.5), material);
    head.position.y = 1;

    const leftArm = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.2, 1, 0.2), material);
    leftArm.position.set(-0.75, 0.5, 0);

    const rightArm = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.2, 1, 0.2), material);
    rightArm.position.set(0.75, 0.5, 0);

    const leftLeg = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.3, 1, 0.3), material);
    leftLeg.position.set(-0.3, -1.25, 0);

    const rightLeg = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.3, 1, 0.3), material);
    rightLeg.position.set(0.3, -1.25, 0);

    humanoid.add(body, head, leftArm, rightArm, leftLeg, rightLeg);
    scene.add(humanoid);

    camera.position.z = 5;

    const ambientLight = new THREE.AmbientLight(0x404040);
    scene.add(ambientLight);

    const directionalLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 1);
    directionalLight.position.set(1, 1, 1);
    scene.add(directionalLight);

    const ground = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(10, 10), new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x808080 }));
    ground.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
    ground.position.y = -2;
    scene.add(ground);

    const clock = new THREE.Clock();
    let elapsed = 0;

    function animate() {
        requestAnimationFrame(animate);
        elapsed = clock.getElapsedTime();
        const cycleTime = 10;
        const cycleElapsed = elapsed % cycleTime;

        if (cycleElapsed < 2) {
            // Stand still
            humanoid.rotation.y = 0;
            leftArm.rotation.x = 0;
            rightArm.rotation.x = 0;
            leftLeg.rotation.x = 0;
            rightLeg.rotation.x = 0;
        } else if (cycleElapsed < 5) {
            // Walk
            const walkTime = cycleElapsed - 2;
            humanoid.rotation.y = 0;
            leftArm.rotation.x = Math.sin(walkTime * 2) * 0.3;
            rightArm.rotation.x = -Math.sin(walkTime * 2) * 0.3;
            leftLeg.rotation.x = -Math.sin(walkTime * 2) * 0.3;
            rightLeg.rotation.x = Math.sin(walkTime * 2) * 0.3;
        } else if (cycleElapsed < 8) {
            // Run
            const runTime = cycleElapsed - 5;
            humanoid.rotation.y = -0.1;
            leftArm.rotation.x = Math.sin(runTime * 6) * 0.6;
            rightArm.rotation.x = -Math.sin(runTime * 6) * 0.6;
            leftLeg.rotation.x = -Math.sin(runTime * 6) * 0.6;
            rightLeg.rotation.x = Math.sin(runTime * 6) * 0.6;
        } else {
            // Stand still again
            humanoid.rotation.y = 0;
            leftArm.rotation.x = 0;
            rightArm.rotation.x = 0;
            leftLeg.rotation.x = 0;
            rightLeg.rotation.x = 0;
        }

        renderer.render(scene, camera);
    }

    animate();

    window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
        const width = window.innerWidth;
        const height = window.innerHeight;
        camera.aspect = width / height;
        camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
        renderer.setSize(width, height);
    });
</script>
</body>
</html>
